"""Block_60x40x12 — Rectangular Four-Hole Block

Coordinate convention: millimetres; origin at the lower-left corner of the bottom face. +X is length, +Y is width, and +Z is thickness.

Requirements implemented:
R01: 60 x 40 x 12 mm rectangular block spanning X=0..60, Y=0..40, Z=0..12.
R02: Four plain Z-directed through holes, diameter 6 mm, at (10,10), (50,10), (10,30), and (50,30).
R03: No fillets, chamfers, counterbores, text, or extra components.
R04-R10 are reserved for downstream geometric validation, capture, rendering, and final review.

BOM: 1 x Block_60x40x12 modeled solid.
"""
from steve import Model

model = Model("Block_60x40x12")
model.box("stock", length=60.0, width=40.0, height=12.0, at=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), centered=False)
model.hole("h1", on="stock.top", points=[(10.0, 10.0)], diameter=6.0, depth=12.0, kind="simple")
model.hole("h2", on="stock.top", points=[(50.0, 10.0)], diameter=6.0, depth=12.0, kind="simple")
model.hole("h3", on="stock.top", points=[(10.0, 30.0)], diameter=6.0, depth=12.0, kind="simple")
model.hole("h4", on="stock.top", points=[(50.0, 30.0)], diameter=6.0, depth=12.0, kind="simple")
result = model.result()
